It was observed that OH-radical-induced formation of 8-oxodG was about twofold enhanced in the presence of PBN, whereas usual OH-radical scavengers inhibited the formation of 8-oxodG beyond expectation.

label_note: The twofold enhancement is defined relative to the no-PBN chemical-system comparison.

input.support_text: It has long been known that chromate-exposed cells contained abundant Cr(III)-DNA adducts. input.support_text: Oligodeoxynucleotide templates bearing the same four N6-styrene oxide adducts (R/S at positions 2 and 3 of N-ras codon 61) were replicated in vitro by the Klenow fragment to evaluate extension competence.
